miningRewards_modelsMiningPowerOnlyNotic.en: Mining starts once the LOOP token launches; until then only power is tracked
miningRewards_modelsMiningPowerOnlyNotic.zh: LOOP 代币上线后开始正式开挖，上线前只统计算力

miningRewards_screenBuild.en: Not enough BNB for the network fee. Swap {from} for {to} first.{need} Come back to claim after the swap; your claimable balance won't change.
miningRewards_screenBuild.zh: BNB 不足以支付网络费，先用 {from} 兑换 {to}。{need}兑换完成后回来再领取，可领取余额不变。

miningRewards_screenBuild2.en: Shown after an hour with power is settled
miningRewards_screenBuild2.zh: 有算力的小时结算后显示

miningRewards_screenBuild3.en: No meme coins counted toward mining last hour
miningRewards_screenBuild3.zh: 上一小时没有计入挖矿的 Meme 币

miningRewards_screenCaption.en: Updates after the next hour is settled

miningRewards_screenConfirming2.en: On-chain and waiting for confirmation. Don't claim again.
miningRewards_screenConfirming2.zh: 已上链，正在等待确认。不要重复领取。

miningRewards_screenDisabledReason.zh: 正在读取最新的可领取数量

miningRewards_screenExpired2.en: The claim voucher expired and nothing was paid out. Your claimable balance is unchanged. You can claim again.
miningRewards_screenExpired2.zh: 领取凭证已过期，没有发放，可领取余额不变。可以重新领取。

miningRewards_screenFailed.en: The on-chain claim failed. Your claimable balance didn't go down.{reasonSuffix}
miningRewards_screenFailed.zh: 链上领取失败，可领取余额没有减少。{reasonSuffix}

miningRewards_screenGasInsufficient.en: Not enough BNB for the network fee. Swap USDT first.
miningRewards_screenGasInsufficient.zh: BNB 不足以支付网络费，先用 USDT 兑换。

miningRewards_screenHeading.en: Settlement results can't be loaded right now

miningRewards_screenIf.en: No LOOP to claim right now
miningRewards_screenIf.zh: 现在没有可领取的 LOOP

miningRewards_screenMiningAssetBasisNote.en: Weighted by amount held: power = average amount held that hour × mining weight
miningRewards_screenMiningAssetBasisNote.zh: 按持有数量加权：算力 = 该小时平均持有数量 × 挖矿权重

miningRewards_screenMiningHourCountedNot.en: Active last hour and counted toward power
miningRewards_screenMiningHourCountedNot.zh: 上一小时有效，已计入算力统计

miningRewards_screenMiningInviteNote.en: Only invitees' own power counts; invitees with zero own power don't count. Equivalent NFT power is used only for reward calculation.
miningRewards_screenMiningInviteNote.zh: 只计下级本人算力，本人算力为 0 的下级不计；等效 NFT 算力只用于奖励计算。

miningRewards_screenMiningMinuteEpochBod.en: Settlement period {clockLabel}–{clockLabel2} · this hour's rewards are fully claimable after settlement
miningRewards_screenMiningMinuteEpochBod.zh: 结算时段 {clockLabel}–{clockLabel2} · 本小时奖励结算后已全部计入可领取

miningRewards_screenMiningNftBasisNote.en: NFT power = amount held × community factor
miningRewards_screenMiningNftBasisNote.zh: NFT 算力 = 持有数量 × 所属社区系数

miningRewards_screenMiningPowerEpochBody.en: Period {clockLabel}–{clockLabel2} · counted every hour on the hour
miningRewards_screenMiningPowerEpochBody.zh: 统计时段 {clockLabel}–{clockLabel2} · 每个整点统计一次

miningRewards_screenMiningPowerTracksBod.zh: NFT 算力 {nftPower} · Meme 币算力 {assetPower}

miningRewards_screenMiningRewardsProvena.en: Every hour on the hour (UTC), the previous hour's NFT and meme coin tracks are settled; that hour's rewards are claimable once settled. The per-minute growth only displays last hour's rewards and doesn't change the claimable amount.
miningRewards_screenMiningRewardsProvena.zh: 每个整点（UTC）结算上一小时的 NFT 与 Meme 币两条轨道；结算完成后该小时奖励即可领取。分钟增长只是展示上一小时的奖励，不改变可领取数量。

miningRewards_screenMiningRewardsProvena.en: Every hour on the hour (UTC), power on the previous hour's NFT and meme coin tracks is counted.
miningRewards_screenMiningRewardsProvena.zh: 每个整点（UTC）统计上一小时 NFT 与 Meme 币两条轨道的算力。

miningRewards_screenNoGasSource.en: There's no BNB in your wallet for the network fee. Top up BNB first.
miningRewards_screenNoGasSource.zh: 钱包里没有 BNB 支付网络费，先充值 BNB。

miningRewards_screenPollTimedOut.en: Broadcast, but no confirmation read yet. It may still be confirming; check again later and don't claim again.
miningRewards_screenPollTimedOut.zh: 已广播，但还没有读到确认。它可能仍在确认中，请稍后再查；不要重复领取。

miningRewards_screenPowerFolio.en: The previous hour settles every hour on the hour; the next hour displays by the minute.
miningRewards_screenPowerFolio.zh: 每个整点结算上一小时，下一小时按分钟展示。

miningRewards_screenPreparing.en: Creating the claim voucher. The wallet hasn't opened yet.
miningRewards_screenPreparing.zh: 正在生成领取凭证，还没有打开钱包。

miningRewards_screenS.en: Power appears after the first hour is settled
miningRewards_screenS.zh: 首个小时结算后开始展示算力

miningRewards_screenS2.en: Power for the previous hour is counted every hour on the hour.
miningRewards_screenS2.zh: 每个整点统计上一小时的算力。

miningRewards_screenS4.en: Claimable amount is below the minimum claim
miningRewards_screenS4.zh: 可领取数量未达到最低领取数量

miningRewards_screenS7.zh: 需要 BNB 支付网络费

miningRewards_screenS8.en: Your wallet has no BNB and no USDT to swap.{need} Top up a little BNB first, then come back to claim.
miningRewards_screenS8.zh: 钱包里没有 BNB，也没有可兑换的 USDT。{need}先向钱包充值少量 BNB，再回来领取。

miningRewards_screenSwitch.en: Mining rules aren't in effect yet, so nothing is settled.
miningRewards_screenSwitch.zh: 挖矿规则待生效，暂时没有结算。

miningRewards_screenSwitch10.en: This claim is locked. Don't claim again.
miningRewards_screenSwitch10.zh: 这笔领取已锁定，不要重复领取。

miningRewards_screenSwitch11.en: The settlement service isn't available right now, so you can't claim
miningRewards_screenSwitch11.zh: 结算服务暂时不可用，暂不能领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch12.en: Mining rules aren't in effect yet, so you can't claim
miningRewards_screenSwitch12.zh: 挖矿规则待生效，暂不能领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch13.en: Claimable after an hour with power is settled
miningRewards_screenSwitch13.zh: 有算力的小时结算后可领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch15.en: The previous claim is still processing. Claim after it finishes
miningRewards_screenSwitch15.zh: 上一笔领取还在处理中，完成后再领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch16.en: The claim chain isn't configured yet, so you can't claim
miningRewards_screenSwitch16.zh: 领取所在的链尚未配置，暂不能领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch17.en: Claim voucher issuing isn't configured yet, so you can't claim
miningRewards_screenSwitch17.zh: 领取凭证签发尚未配置，暂不能领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch18.en: On-chain writes are off right now, so you can't claim
miningRewards_screenSwitch18.zh: 链上写入暂时关闭，暂不能领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch2.en: Mining rules are in effect. Power for the previous hour is counted every hour on the hour and shown here.
miningRewards_screenSwitch2.zh: 挖矿规则已生效。每个整点统计上一小时的算力，统计后显示在这里。

miningRewards_screenSwitch20.en: The claim contract is paused, so you can't claim
miningRewards_screenSwitch20.zh: 领取合约已暂停，暂不能领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch21.en: The claim contract can't be read right now, so you can't claim
miningRewards_screenSwitch21.zh: 领取合约暂时读不到，暂不能领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch22.en: The claim contract's balance is too low, so you can't claim
miningRewards_screenSwitch22.zh: 领取合约余额不足，暂不能领取

miningRewards_screenSwitch24.en: No LOOP to claim right now.
miningRewards_screenSwitch24.zh: 现在没有可领取的 LOOP。

miningRewards_screenSwitch25.en: Claimable amount is below the minimum claim.
miningRewards_screenSwitch25.zh: 可领取数量低于最低领取数量。

miningRewards_screenSwitch26.en: The previous claim is still processing. Claim after it finishes.
miningRewards_screenSwitch26.zh: 上一笔领取还在处理中，完成后再领取。

miningRewards_screenSwitch27.en: The simulation didn't pass; this claim would be rejected on-chain. No transaction was submitted.
miningRewards_screenSwitch27.zh: 试算没有通过，这笔领取在链上会被拒绝。没有提交任何交易。

miningRewards_screenSwitch28.en: The claim contract is paused. Your balance is unchanged.
miningRewards_screenSwitch28.zh: 领取合约已暂停，余额不变。

miningRewards_screenSwitch29.en: The claim contract can't be read right now. No voucher was created and your balance is unchanged.
miningRewards_screenSwitch29.zh: 领取合约暂时读不到，没有生成领取凭证，余额不变。

miningRewards_screenSwitch3.en: The settlement service isn't available right now. The numbers below may not be current.
miningRewards_screenSwitch3.zh: 结算服务暂时不可用，下面的数字可能不是最新的。

miningRewards_screenSwitch30.en: The claim contract's balance is too low to claim right now. Your balance is unchanged.
miningRewards_screenSwitch30.zh: 领取合约余额不足，暂时不能领取，余额不变。

miningRewards_screenSwitch31.en: The claim voucher expired. No transaction was submitted. Claim again.
miningRewards_screenSwitch31.zh: 领取凭证已过期，没有提交任何交易。请重新领取。

miningRewards_screenSwitch32.en: Claims go only to your LOOP built-in wallet.
miningRewards_screenSwitch32.zh: 只能领取到 LOOP 内置钱包。

miningRewards_screenSwitch33.en: No voucher was created and no transaction was submitted.
miningRewards_screenSwitch33.zh: 没有生成领取凭证，没有提交任何交易。

miningRewards_screenSwitch35.en: Graduated; DEX pool holdings are still syncing
miningRewards_screenSwitch35.zh: 已毕业，外盘持有数量还在同步

miningRewards_screenSwitch36.en: Graduated; DEX pool holdings can't be read right now
miningRewards_screenSwitch36.zh: 已毕业，外盘持有数量暂读不到

miningRewards_screenSwitch4.en: Mining rules are in effect. The previous hour settles every hour on the hour; it's then shown here by the minute and can be claimed.
miningRewards_screenSwitch4.zh: 挖矿规则已生效。每个整点结算上一小时，结算后这里按分钟展示，并可领取。

miningRewards_screenSwitch5.en: Settlement data can't be loaded right now. The numbers below may not be current.
miningRewards_screenSwitch5.zh: 结算数据暂时读不到，下面的数字可能不是最新的。

miningRewards_screenSwitch6.en: Hours you had power in aren't settled yet
miningRewards_screenSwitch6.zh: 你有算力的小时还没有结算

miningRewards_screenSwitch7.en: Rewards appear after the first hour is settled
miningRewards_screenSwitch7.zh: 首个小时结算后开始展示奖励

miningRewards_screenSwitch9.en: Submitted and waiting to land on-chain (checked {attempts} times). Don't claim again.
miningRewards_screenSwitch9.zh: 已提交，正在等待上链（已读取 {attempts} 次）。不要重复领取。

miningRewards_screenTimedOut.en: Network unavailable. No claim voucher was created.
miningRewards_screenTimedOut.zh: 网络不可用，没有生成领取凭证。

miningRewards_screenUnavailable.en: Claims aren't available right now. Your balance is unchanged.
miningRewards_screenUnavailable.zh: 领取暂不可用，余额不变。

miningRewards_signingIf.en: The wallet result is unknown, so this claim is locked. Don't claim again; refresh later to check.
miningRewards_signingIf.zh: 钱包的结果未知，这笔领取已锁定。不要重复领取，稍后刷新查看。

miningRewards_signingIf2.en: Broadcast ({short}) and recorded by the server; waiting for on-chain confirmation.
miningRewards_signingIf2.zh: 已广播（{short}），服务端已记录，正在等待链上确认。

miningRewards_signingSwitch.zh: 已取消，没有发生任何变化。

miningRewards_signingSwitch10.en: The wallet didn't finish signing. No transaction was submitted and your claimable balance is unchanged.
miningRewards_signingSwitch10.zh: 钱包没有完成签名，没有提交任何交易，可领取余额不变。

miningRewards_signingSwitch11.en: A different hash was already reported for this claim, so this broadcast wasn't recorded. Don't claim again; refresh later to check.
miningRewards_signingSwitch11.zh: 这笔领取已经上报过另一笔哈希，本次广播没有被记录。不要重复领取，稍后刷新查看。

miningRewards_signingSwitch12.en: This on-chain transaction doesn't match the claim voucher, so the server didn't record it. Don't claim again, and contact support.
miningRewards_signingSwitch12.zh: 链上这笔交易与领取凭证不一致，服务端没有记录它。不要重复领取，并联系支持。

miningRewards_signingSwitch13.en: The wallet broadcast it, but the report didn't arrive. The transaction may be on-chain; you can report the same hash again. Don't claim again.
miningRewards_signingSwitch13.zh: 钱包已经广播，但上报没有送达。交易可能已经上链，可以重新上报同一笔哈希；不要重复领取。

miningRewards_signingSwitch2.zh: 身份验证没有通过，没有发生任何变化。

miningRewards_signingSwitch3.en: The claim voucher expired. No transaction was submitted and your claimable balance is unchanged. Claim again.
miningRewards_signingSwitch3.zh: 领取凭证已过期，没有提交任何交易，可领取余额不变。请重新领取。

miningRewards_signingSwitch4.en: The transaction doesn't match what you confirmed, so signing was refused. No transaction was submitted.
miningRewards_signingSwitch4.zh: 交易内容与确认内容不一致，已拒绝签名，没有提交任何交易。

miningRewards_signingSwitch5.en: Couldn't find the wallet for this claim. No transaction was submitted.
miningRewards_signingSwitch5.zh: 找不到这笔领取的钱包，没有提交任何交易。

miningRewards_signingSwitch6.en: The voucher's wallet doesn't match the current wallet, so signing was refused. No transaction was submitted.
miningRewards_signingSwitch6.zh: 领取凭证对应的钱包与当前钱包不一致，已拒绝签名，没有提交任何交易。

miningRewards_signingSwitch7.en: Signing isn't allowed on this chain. No transaction was submitted.
miningRewards_signingSwitch7.zh: 这条链不允许签名，没有提交任何交易。

miningRewards_signingSwitch8.en: The wallet can't sign on this chain right now. No transaction was submitted.
miningRewards_signingSwitch8.zh: 钱包暂时不能在这条链上签名，没有提交任何交易。

miningRewards_signingSwitch9.en: The signed-in wallet isn't the one for this claim. No transaction was submitted.
miningRewards_signingSwitch9.zh: 当前登录的钱包不是这笔领取的钱包，没有提交任何交易。
